messages.content: {"task": "Translate EVERY supplied row into Russian. Return JSON only: {\"rows\":[{\"source_id\":\"exact supplied id\",\"target\":\"complete Russian translation\"}]}. Keep every row in order. Preserve all [[I]], [[B]], [[SC]] emphasis markers, [[Nnumber]] note markers and explicit source line counts. Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "Les Misérables", "unit": 279, "heading": "II GAITÉS PRÉALABLES", "previous_rows": [], "source_language": "French", "part": 4, "book": 12, "chapter": 2, "role": "CHAPTER"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "fr81-u279-h", "tag": "heading", "text": "II GAITÉS PRÉALABLES", "sha256": "f13e1e8b4fcfee30718f6879b8e60ae6f6ff872f767a5a01590e6a06d86c604b", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u279-r0001", "tag": "prose", "text": "Laigle de Meaux, on le sait, demeurait plutôt chez Joly qu’ailleurs. Il avait un logis comme l’oiseau a une branche. Les deux amis vivaient ensemble, mangeaient ensemble, dormaient ensemble. Tout leur était commun, même un peu Musichetta. Ils étaient ce que, chez les frères chapeaux, on appelle [[I]]bini[[/I]]. Le matin du 5 juin, ils s’en allèrent déjeuner à Corinthe. Joly, enchifrené, avait un fort coryza que Laigle commençait à partager. L’habit de Laigle était râpé, mais Joly était bien mis.", "sha256": "c5b738d6aee5c430ed9d1916d91776a69b54181e567f5342fc1300e6460e12c6", "emphasis_spans": 1, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u279-r0002", "tag": "prose", "text": "Il était environ neuf heures du matin quand ils poussèrent la porte de Corinthe.", "sha256": "20323b09b8d7021889896fc8cd7296cfa7f25e055a5f7577f449db4e1ea23dba", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u279-r0003", "tag": "prose", "text": "Ils montèrent au premier.", "sha256": "2848399f8e53d8870fe7aa536557ec726d2d780243b32a1c169ef37e85d1357e", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u279-r0004", "tag": "prose", "text": "Matelote et Gibelotte les reçurent.", "sha256": "419439a2e7b020d66cd306ef897a0ceefd658ec6d93df55add28335cc81cdbd7", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u279-r0005", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Huîtres, fromage et jambon, dit Laigle.", "sha256": "95c74b0c2762ed590d100fbcfa642d1c1f616fa4bf1a44ef3f5d6686d14eca22", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u279-r0006", "tag": "prose", "text": "Et ils s’attablèrent.", "sha256": "0b6f66df12ba54cd362f73796888ab5b70b2dfa4d1b94e712212c294014a26fb", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u279-r0007", "tag": "prose", "text": "Le cabaret était vide ; il n’y avait qu’eux deux.", "sha256": "20809482aa27474d42de7f0cda688203897588ca6fbc4fe95f9ee79462fb39f2", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u279-r0008", "tag": "prose", "text": "Gibelotte, reconnaissant Joly et Laigle, mit une bouteille de vin sur la table.", "sha256": "aa8ec473538fd5ccf965ae9c02d0379b828521a800b179127b40aa6f86c582ef", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u279-r0009", "tag": "prose", "text": "Comme ils étaient aux premières huîtres, une tête apparut à l’écoutille de l’escalier, et une voix dit :", "sha256": "0bd6e5ef22017c1a36183c49dfbccbd7406e68cfd44ea9fad88e9b6366ed1d9f", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u279-r0010", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Je passais. J’ai senti, de la rue, une délicieuse odeur de fromage de Brie. J’entre.", "sha256": "7dceea0bdca949bda5baad7d96c7ce3d88e5e3ded0d5961c2a0969897f1f1082", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u279-r0011", "tag": "prose", "text": "C’était Grantaire.", "sha256": "481c336360ae8ce2722acca1a0b88fb414b6c7d929f2414f8b527f8f09a44473", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u279-r0012", "tag": "prose", "text": "Grantaire prit un tabouret et s’attabla.", "sha256": "cf3806a7bed4322db6d4445bdfd2f82dd186dbfbbbfa731212850ad0c380acb3", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u279-r0013", "tag": "prose", "text": "Gibelotte, voyant Grantaire, mit deux bouteilles de vin sur la table.", "sha256": "e14fbd80270a7f58376f4f8850454bdb6ea92febd23291a3aaffdcb297a8c348", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u279-r0014", "tag": "prose", "text": "Cela fit trois.", "sha256": "d0f3c4452738b55476cca60f7a6b514adcac1e3ac704cb52dfce50f127630e73", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u279-r0015", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Est-ce que tu vas boire ces deux bouteilles ? demanda Laigle à Grantaire.", "sha256": "6ffe044857a89bdd459a7c1b5b77b6bcc776f365f6e44b1abe8e25a771094de8", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u279-r0016", "tag": "prose", "text": "Grantaire répondit :", "sha256": "a6699dbb1d655e3721b99332c56d35e945f451459b51a9acbd516a0480040a06", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u279-r0017", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Tous sont ingénieux, toi seul es ingénu. Deux bouteilles n’ont jamais étonné un homme.", "sha256": "a367abe6e6978499d6eaedd20ab8e0e356f6da4242a1f7228e4a7f5b2089f351", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u279-r0018", "tag": "prose", "text": "Les autres avaient commencé par manger, Grantaire commença par boire. Une demi-bouteille fut vivement engloutie.", "sha256": "e86a196ea0998f96d428e21a7da8765b3209fdc7cddc4d2d6f7e495be92a88c0", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u279-r0019", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Tu as donc un trou à l’estomac ? reprit Laigle.", "sha256": "26f9a76faca57e1cf244db10612a91e38d8f3d4430db759132181c89f14cd404", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u279-r0020", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Tu en as bien un au coude, dit Grantaire.", "sha256": "c635a5fcbcd2e88979065c2e8b3472df3bfa2f694e605e535d4f273ff51057eb", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u279-r0021", "tag": "prose", "text": "Et, après avoir vidé son verre, il ajouta :", "sha256": "b2df428f4e25d522835a209211f17f62024c7f9fbd25cc9a7e8d3322ead95dc0", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u279-r0022", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Ah ça, Laigle des oraisons funèbres, ton habit est vieux.", "sha256": "0cfba91d0f0201424473f596661d79872e330fbb207a626debb84ab454e0ddb4", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u279-r0023", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Je l’espère, repartit Laigle. Cela fait que nous faisons bon ménage, mon habit et moi. Il a pris tous mes plis, il ne me gêne en rien, il s’est moulé sur mes difformités, il est complaisant à tous mes mouvements ; je ne le sens que parce qu’il me tient chaud. Les vieux habits, c’est la même chose que les vieux amis.", "sha256": "8b8a4457bc61579aa0d906843e73c51f6a94de29fa05c870f0be08c40728e98d", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u279-r0024", "tag": "prose", "text": "— C’est vrai, s’écria Joly entrant dans le dialogue, un vieil habit est un vieil abi.", "sha256": "43168bcb84631c26d6388949a2036efe066e86b576d6e8335c8bcb75df458c08", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u279-r0025", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Surtout, dit Grantaire, dans la bouche d’un homme enchifrené.", "sha256": "71b63603094985d5cbb25a6e468addc787c90516b973c0671d29792ab26b5b41", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u279-r0026", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Grantaire, demanda Laigle, viens-tu du boulevard ?", "sha256": "c17d5b991d0a9ccc17ffe416ce7be823f4005bf18d37b5681466ac8791be2fd4", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u279-r0027", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Non.", "sha256": "ac641d7ffd6b132ddcd7d7944dc3ccc96acf3113cab60712c9516858cbfdaab2", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u279-r0028", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Nous venons de voir passer la tête du cortège, Joly et moi.", "sha256": "7c863ba48bee2a618a8dccd01d82770faa84f295b3c8650a22d22cc9d769a804", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u279-r0029", "tag": "prose", "text": "— C’est un spectacle berveilleux, dit Joly.", "sha256": "68c82882a2799aca21f85795c8a81c2797a9924ce74a5ea8422bd6dd95bd8d5f", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u279-r0030", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Comme cette rue est tranquille ! s’écria Laigle. Qui est-ce qui se douterait que Paris est sens dessus dessous ? Comme on voit que c’était jadis tout couvents par ici ! Du Breul et Sauval en donnent la liste, et l’abbé Lebeuf. Il y en avait tout autour, ça fourmillait, des chaussés, des déchaussés, des tondus, des barbus, des gris, des noirs, des blancs, des franciscains, des minimes, des capucins, des carmes, des petits augustins, des grands augustins, des vieux augustins… — Ça pullulait.", "sha256": "d4f3291c7d7cfdb2627bedafc7c1fda39800dd57ee9b0652ba9e584bc04d6a9a", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u279-r0031", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Ne parlons pas de moines, interrompit Grantaire, cela donne envie de se gratter.", "sha256": "0e8e3b7596d2b3e69e61f292febc076726e2821f5e49b521df5facc08b32e87b", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}]}
